Build the gsm.viz bars spec for the prevalence plot

Source: R/mod_PrevalencePlot.R
BuildPrevalenceSpec.Rd

The predecessor overlaid the three VizLevel series at one y position and told them apart by bar width. bars has no per-series width control, so the series would fully occlude each other under position = "identity"; dodge carries the same comparison with position instead of width.

Usage

BuildPrevalenceSpec(strCategory)

Arguments

strCategory

character A category to focus on.

Value

A gsm.vizr::bars_spec() list.
